Equality Ohio claims to advocate for LGBTQ people & has #BlackLivesMatter & #BlackTransLivesMatter in their bio.

But when faced with threats from fascists, they seriously told folks not to counter-protest & assured people that the cops(!) would protect the event.

@EqualityOhio How are you gonna be an LGBTQ org with #BlackLivesMatter & #BlackTransLivesMatter in your bio & then seriously tell people that the cops will protect queer & trans people?

Has Equality Ohio learned nothing from the last few years much less the last few decades?
